{{recipe}}
==Ingredients==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Whole Wheat|whole wheat]] [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]] or [[Cookbook:Jaggery|jaggery]]
* 1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon powder]]
* 2 cups [[Cookbook:Soy Milk|soy milk]]
* 4 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Oil|oil]]

==Procedure==
#Mix together flour, baking powder, and sugar.
#Mix soy milk into the dry mixture.
#Heat a [[Cookbook:Griddle|griddle]] until water sprinkled on it quickly evaporates. Spread a thin film of oil on the griddle.
#Pour pancake batter on griddle to form 2–3-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] circles. Bubbles should start forming.
#When the underside is light brown, flip the pancake.
#When the other side is light brown, serve.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
*For lighter pancakes use half white, and half whole-wheat flour
